mathematical_or_operational_scope: Characteristic-zero polynomial reconstruction of Q, three upper resultants R, the adjacent-tail elimination W, a five-parameter coefficient circuit, and a modular Jacobian witness.
positive_controls: Lines 57–105 reconstruct determinants directly using SymPy’s algebraic coefficient field and compare exact polynomials with inert JSON; this is stronger than merely matching a few sample evaluations.
Lines 73–75 and 97–100 assert affine dependence on t,beta; lines 89–90 check gamma-linearity. W is independently reconstructed as a coefficient determinant.

findings.issue: Nested zip loops do not enforce saved coefficient dimensions. Keeping a 3x3 upper_matrix but replacing each entry’s three coefficient-polynomial records with [] makes line 123 perform zero comparisons; internally reconstructed polys still populate Ecoeff, so the downstream full witness is unchanged and H_circuit_coefficients_match=True is still emitted. Extra supplied entries are also silently ignored.

records_poly has no exact index/length/type schema; Python negative indices, arbitrary coefficient-vector lengths, duplicate monomials and int coercion can normalize malformed records. Input metadata variable orders and declared field are not checked against the hard-coded reconstruction.
Loaded witness modulus/root are not independently validated as a prime and primitive eighth root. The hard-coded W reduction is distinct from these loaded witness paths.

A nonzero Jacobian minor at the provided parameters proves generic polynomial differential independence, subject to a valid reduction. There is no assertion that those parameters solve Q=R1=R2=R5=0; it does not establish codimension, smoothness or existence on that common zero locus.
Every exact equality/acceptance gate is an assert. Optimized Python would discard checks while retaining success output.

cost_and_scaling: Determinants here are small fixed 3x3 and 4x4 Leibniz expansions (6 or 24 summands), but sparse polynomial products and coefficient growth can dominate. Generic det(M) is factorial in dimension. This is polynomial/certificate preprocessing, not an asymptotic FFT improvement.
test_scope_and_limits: No program execution. The source intends exact Q/R/W comparisons, a full H coefficient comparison (with the stated truncation flaw), fixed W/H reductions, and one Jacobian minor. No malformed-schema, empty-list or optimized-mode tests are present.
certificate_acceptance: Do not treat its H coefficient-match field as a complete supplied-circuit validation until all three dimensions, coefficient schemas and metadata are enforced. Exact Q/R/W assertions remain substantially stronger checks within their hard-coded coordinate convention.
